lines.text: I saw a stranger’s hands today
And something in me slipped away
Suddenly I’m five years old again
Swinging hard between the two of them
They’d lift me like the world was light
Laughing while the sidewalk blurred
I never knew that kind of height
Could leave a mark that still endures
Hold me in the middle
One hand left and one hand right
Hold me in the middle
Don’t let go just yet tonight
I’d give anything to feel that safe
To be that small and free
Hold me in the middle
One more time for me
Now their hands are only memories
Faded photos on the shelf
I still reach for what I used to need
And find I’m holding only myself
Hold me in the middle
One hand left and one hand right
Hold me in the middle
Don’t let go just yet tonight
I’d give anything to feel that safe
To be that small and free
Hold me in the middle
One more time for me
I’m tired of being the strong one
Tired of saying that I’m fine
Some nights I still want to be carried
Want someone else’s hands in mine
I don’t need the whole world fixed
I just want to feel that small again
Just for a minute…
Just for a minute
Hold me in the middle
One hand left and one hand right
Hold me in the middle
Don’t let go just yet tonight
I’d give anything to feel that safe
To be that small and free
Hold me in the middle
One more time for me
